messages:
elena: Heads-up: runtime landed defaults change (batching -> \"aggressive\" + new quant profile `q8-dynmix`). We need a 2-line relnote for the site, a migration snippet, and to update both py/js SDK examples. Tagging @rachel for prose + snippets and @samir for migration CLI.
rachel: On it. Can someone paste the precise user-facing bullets we should surface? I want the relnote to be concise and the examples to be copy-paste ready.
samir: From runtime: (A) default `batching.policy` now `\"aggressive\"` to favor throughput for long sequences; (B) new quant profile `q8-dynmix` available on x86-gpu images; (C) q4_0/q4_1 remain supported but are marked deprecated in the console. Also add a short rollback knob for customers.
elena: Important: include a Known Issue — in low-concurrency single-worker setups, sub-100-token latency can regress ~10-25ms. Provide opt-out steps and a per-route override example.
rachel: Draft relnote copy: \"Serving defaults updated: batching set to 'aggressive' to improve throughput for long-sequence workloads. A new quant profile `q8-dynmix` is available; legacy q4_* profiles remain supported but are deprecated. Known issue: small-sequence latency may increase in certain low-concurrency environments; see migration section for opt-out instructions.\" Thoughts?
samir: Solid. Migration extras: add Console -> Settings screenshot steps to set global override to `batching.policy=none`; CLI for private deployers; and `redwoodctl` rollback example. CLI draft: ```bash
redwoodctl config set --name global --batching.policy=none --quant_profile=q4_1
# verify
redwoodctl config get global
```
ops-signal: Also include a short ops note: Dedicated customers should canary this change in a staging cluster with traffic shaping (70% short, 30% long sequences) and monitor p50/p95 for <100 token requests. Add a playbook link to Dedicated handbook.
docops-bot: scheduled link check (run id 61234). Will report anchor issues back here.
docops-bot: link check complete (run id 61234)  1 broken anchor found: /docs/runtime/kernel-selection#old-kernels -> should be /docs/runtime/kernel-selection#kernel-selection. Issue filed: DOCS-887.
rachel: OK I'll update the relnote PR: add the Python and JS opt-out snippets, the CLI rollback, and the Known Issue callout with the ops canary recommendation. Draft Python snippet for the docs: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate(
    model=\"redwood-1-small\",
    prompt=prompt,
    config={\"batching\": {\"policy\": \"none\"}, \"quant_profile\": \"q4_1\"}
)
```
rachel: JS equivalent to include too.
elena: Also add a short note in the changelog entry that we deprecated q4_* names and link to the migration guide for pinning quant profiles per-call and per-deployment.
samir: For private deployments, include a systemd restart hint and the `redwoodctl` verify command in the migration guide.
ops-signal: I'll add the Dedicated rollout checklist to the PR comments so release manager can assign canary windows.
elena: Action items: Rachel -> push relnote + py/js snippets + changelog bullet; Samir -> add CLI + private-deploy verification steps; Ops -> attach Dedicated canary checklist; DocOps -> resolve DOCS-887 and re-run link checks. Merge relnote after snippets land and link check is clean. :thumbsup:
